internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The 41 occurrences of ج ب ل split, along an exact morphological seam, into two Quran-internally UNBRIDGED classes. Class A (39/41), the non-geminate stem jabal/jibāl, denotes a mountain — a massive, elevated, firmly-founded rock-mass, deployed as the corpus's benchmark of magnitude and fixity across creation/stabilization, eschatological dissolution, and theophany/worship registers. Class B (2/41), the geminate stem jibill- (jibillah), denotes a large created multitude/generation of people, with no geological sense. Every non-mountain token is geminate and every mountain token is not; the morphology tracks the semantic split with zero exceptions. No occurrence uses jibāl for people or jibill- for terrain, and no verse bridges the two. The only thing joining them is the QAC root label, an etymological assignment, not a Quran-internal semantic demonstration; adopting it as a bridge would import a forbidden external lexical prior. Because two senses share a skeleton with no in-corpus bridge, the honest result is a multi-class UNRESOLVED partition rather than a forced single nucleus. (Note: Class A considered alone is a strong, distinctive, adversarially-clean lexeme — but that is a class-scoped observation, not a root-level nucleus.)
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: jbl (Class A, mountain) does NOT entail permanence or immovability: fixedness is a repeated but God-granted, revocable state (pegs 78:7, anchored 79:32, set up 88:19), voided at will as mountains are set moving (52:10, 81:3, 18:47), pulverized (69:14, 56:5), scattered (77:10, 20:105), and reduced to carded wool (101:5, 70:9), sand-heap (73:14), or mirage (78:20); 27:88 explicitly labels their solidity merely apparent (tahsabuhā jāmidatan wa-hiya tamurru). It does NOT entail inert insentience: they prostrate (22:18), glorify (21:79, 38:18), are addressed and respond (34:10), and would be humbled and split from awe (59:21). It is not exclusively terrestrial rock: 24:43 applies jibāl to mountainous masses in the sky. Class A does not extend to people; Class B (jibill-, human multitude) does not extend to terrain — the two references are disjoint. No verbal/action semantics is extractable: the root is nominal-only (41/41 tagged N).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 36:62:4:1 «وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا»: the governing verb أَضَلَّ (led astray), the partitive مِنكُمْ (of you), and the quantifier كَثِيرًا (a great number) make the referent a numerous body of persons, and the stem is morphologically geminate (jibil~FA). A mountain sense is impossible, not merely strained. Corroborated by 26:184:4:3 «خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ», where jibillah is an object of khalaqa paired with 'you' and 'the former ones'. This decisively blocks any single-nucleus unification of the root.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: The best unifying account: one nucleus 'a massive/bulky created aggregate', realized concretely as a mass of rock (mountains) and as a mass of created humanity (jibillah). Internal hooks exist (24:43 shows jibāl is not intrinsically terrestrial rock but massed formation; 26:184 frames jibillah as an object of khalaqa). It is rejected on three contract grounds: (1) narrowest-account test — 'massive aggregate' is a vague abstraction that fits almost any large-quantity root and is not useful; (2) no Quran-internal bridge — not one occurrence uses jibāl for people or jibill- for terrain, and the classes never co-occur in a mediating usage; (3) total morpho-semantic segregation — gemination separates the two senses with zero exceptions. Whether Class B is a derivational extension of Class A or a separate homonymic lexeme cannot be decided from the corpus. Offered only as the strongest competitor, not the result.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses independently reach the same structural fact: the root partitions into a dominant, internally coherent, distinctive mountain lexeme (39/41) and a segregated, geminate, lexicalized 'created-multitude' lexeme (2/41), with NO Quran-internal bridge between them. Per the contract, when two or more senses (including homonyms) have no in-corpus bridge, the honest verdict is UNRESOLVED — one must not force a single nucleus, and any bridge here requires forbidden external etymology. clusters.classification_rationale: Both tokens carry the geminate stem (jibil~apa / jibil~FA), a systematic morphological discontinuity from Class A, and both take human referents under verbs (create, lead astray) and human quantifiers/partitives that make a mountain reading impossible.
